Google Threat Intelligence Group has moved away from the 'APT' numbering system to a new scheme using memorable names and country-coded suffixes to track over 5,000 activity clusters.

The Poison:
Standardization can sometimes lead to over-simplification of complex, amorphous criminal networks that don't fit neat country-based labels.

No plane error detected. The logic holds across the metaphysical and historical planes.
